business: TradeCatch (bilingual AI phone receptionist for Québec contractors), CAD, before sales tax
notes: unit = one client-month. days_per_month is 1 on purpose, so the tool's 'per day' columns read as 'active clients' and 'per month'.
price = 299, an ESTIMATE of a 50/50 mix of Essential (249) and Professional (349). Run --price 249 and --price 349 for each plan.

variable = cost of one client-month with the voice minutes and texts FULLY used (the plan allowance in src/lib/plans.ts, which is provisional). Real use is lower, so margin here is a floor. Sources and arithmetic: founder/cfo-sources.md.

The setup fee (1,999.99) cannot be a per-unit price in this tool. It is entered as a NEGATIVE fixed line: 1 new client a month x (1,999.99 - 58.30 card fee) = 1,941.69. That matches the ramp below (one net new client a month). If sales stop, that income stops: see founder/cfo.md for the break-even without it.
ramp = +1 net client a month. ESTIMATE from the panel: about 20 demos a month at the panel's 5% buy rate is 1 sale a month, with referrals offsetting any cancellations.

ESTIMATES the founder must replace with real figures: founder living wage, LiveKit plan, other hosting and software, startup legal and accounting, demos a month, plan mix. capacity_per_day is left out on purpose: hours per install and per customer per month are not known yet.
